# Watchpoints, tracing and coverage (`watch`)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate.mjs. Do not edit; run `npm run generate` (drift fails `npm run check`). -->

Area `watch` is owned by WP9-WATCH; its contracts live in `src/contracts/areas/watch.ts`.

## `watch_memory` — Watch Memory

Log what accesses an address without stopping the target. debug_register: 4 hardware slots, size 1/2/4/8 aligned, all threads including new ones; page_guard: any size, page-granular, exact instruction, and while armed the target's own system calls into the page fail (use debug_register for I/O buffers); poll: sample a range every interval_ms and record value changes (struct exploration). Hits give the accessing instruction (module+RVA, static VA, text), thread, value and the struct base derived from its base register. Bounded; blocks up to wait_ms.

| Phase | Hints | Effects                           | Gate | CLI                                        |

| `session_id`         | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`             | yes      | —         | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                                                                                                                                                                  |

## `trace_execution` — Trace Execution

Record executed code with Stalker on chosen threads, or for the next N invocations of one function (on_call): coverage (unique blocks), block_counts (exact hits) or calls (call edges). Bounded by duration and events; queues are tuned and drops are counted, never silent. calls mode can slow call-heavy code ~90x. Summary gives per-module and per-function block counts; export with export_coverage.

| Phase | Hints | Effects                           | Gate | CLI                              |

| `session_id`  | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —            | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `mode`        | "coverage" \| "block_counts" \| "calls"                                 | no       | `"coverage"` |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `thread_ids`  | array<integer 0..4294967295> ≤16                                        | no       | —            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `on_call`     | string ≤600                                                             | no       | —            | 0xVA \| module+0xRVA \| +0xRVA (main) \| module!export[+0xN] \| module!#ordinal \| module:0xSTATIC_VA[/0xSTATIC_BASE] \| $main:0xSTATIC_VA; quote names with + or spaces; module@0xBASE picks one of two same-named modules |

| `wait_ms`     | integer 0..60000                                                        | no       | `0`          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `max_events`  | integer 1..50000000                                                     | no       | `1000000`    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

## `export_coverage` — Export Coverage

Write block coverage from a trace_execution recording, a call_function result or an emu_call result (its evidence id) to a new drcov v2 file (module-relative, ASLR-independent; for Lighthouse or Cartographer) or a module+offset text list. Never overwrites; default path is under BEA_HOME/runs. Returns path, sha256, block and module counts and blocks per function.

| Phase | Hints | Effects                          | Gate | CLI                                                                                                          |
| ----- | ----- | -------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| P2    | —     | writesFilesystem, mutatesSession | —    | scenario: Session state cannot cross CLI processes; use it from MCP or as a step of `bea run scenario.json`. |

| Input field    | Type                       | Required | Default   | Description                            |
| -------------- | -------------------------- | -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `recording_id` | string `^rec_[0-9a-f]{8}$` | no       | —         |                                        |
| `evidence_id`  | string `^ev_[a-f0-9]{64}$` | no       | —         |                                        |
| `format`       | "drcov" \| "modoff"        | no       | `"drcov"` |                                        |
| `out_path`     | string ≤4096               | no       | —         | New file; default under BEA_HOME/runs. |

Deadline 60,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.coverage.export` · sessions none · results carry untrusted target content.
